correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the base e-BH rejection event exactly. Under the complete null FDR equals the rejection probability; iid two-point inputs reduce it to a binomial tail. Validity forces \(c\le1/p\), monotonicity makes \(c=1/p\) worst at fixed \(p\), threshold partitioning yields the finite maximum, and analytic factorial-moment/Bonferroni inequalities prove the stated low-\(\alpha\) unique optimizer. Computations only check reported numerics and finite instances.
